classifications.rationale: The President presently declares a national emergency and invokes statutory Ready Reserve authority, making that authority immediately available to specified military officials according to its terms.
classifications.evidence: hereby declare that a national emergency exists at the southern border of the United States

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory determination that the emergency requires the Armed Forces and invokes section 2808 construction authority; the legal consequence occurs in the proclamation itself.
classifications.evidence: the construction authority provided in section 2808 of title 10, United States Code, is invoked and made available

classifications.rationale: The President directs the relevant military secretaries to decide, within their discretion and applicable law, how many Ready Reserve personnel should be activated to support border activities; the segment does not dictate a particular activation result.
classifications.evidence: as the Secretary concerned, in the Secretary's discretion, determines to be appropriate

classifications.rationale: The named secretaries must take appropriate implementing actions, but whether and how to act—including any jurisdictional transfer—remains conditional and discretionary; the accompanying disclaimer creates no enforceable right or benefit.
classifications.evidence: shall take all appropriate actions, consistent with applicable law, to use or support the use of the authorities herein invoked
